## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation / Use Case

Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

**Example use case:**
- As a [type of user]
- I want [to perform this action]
- So that [I can achieve this goal]

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Include any relevant details about:

- API changes (if applicable)
- Database schema changes (if applicable)
- Configuration changes (if applicable)
- UI changes (if applicable)

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered. Why did you choose this approach?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Notes

If you have technical implementation ideas, please share them here.
